note: LA.27. extract_graphql_resolver_nodes (parsers/code/extractors/src/graphql.rs) runs on every code file of every language: the type-level RESOLVER_PATTERNS use source.find("type Query {") anywhere and the SDL block scan reads any line that starts with `type Query {` / `type Mutation {` / `type Subscription {`, so a Rust comment, a Rust test raw string and a Python comment mint resolvers (the glia self-build mints graphql_resolver:Query from the comment in engine/src/route.rs). SDL in code counts only inside a GraphQL-marked literal: server/schema.ts (gql tag) and server/type_defs.py (Ariadne gql("""...""")) are the controls. No cells binding: a precision guard, not a language x mechanism cell.
